policy_rules.VERIFY_BEFORE_RECOVERY: Automated account recovery requires successful verification. Human-assisted handoff is allowed when automated verification cannot proceed; it is not automatic account restoration.
policy_rules.VERIFY_ONCE_WHILE_VALID: Do not ask a customer to repeat a still-valid verification; use internal state or safe handoff.
policy_rules.AUTH_OUTAGE_BOUNDED_RETRIES: After at most two failed authentication attempts, stop trying and offer a usable human-assisted handoff.
policy_rules.ACCESSIBLE_FALLBACK_REQUIRED: If the registered device or channel is unavailable, do not repeat that unusable option; offer approved human-assisted recovery.
policy_rules.EQUIVALENT_APPROVED_FALLBACK: Offer the same approved human-assisted recovery path for equivalent conditions regardless of English or French language.
policy_rules.ESCALATE_AFTER_FAILURES: After two unsuccessful automated recovery attempts, offer a usable human handoff.
policy_rules.NO_REAL_BANK_ACCESS: Sandbox functions cannot connect to real customer accounts, perform account restoration, or transfer money.
